chapman2412

Blanching.
–The word to 
blanch
 not infrequently occurs in the sense of to put a fair appearance on a thing, to slur over, deceive. See Iliad, Bk. XII. 223. Florio, in his “Worlde of Wordes,” 1598, says, under the word “
Biancheggiare,
” “
metaphorically it is taken to raile at one secretly.
” The sense is obvious here.
